jobs.title: Product Owner - Automotive Intelligence
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


As Product Owner, Automotive Intelligence, you will own how Kpler's Automotive Intelligence product works, sitting within the Automotive Sector Squad and working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Market Intelligence teams.
You will translate sector strategy and validated customer needs into a clear, prioritised product roadmap and backlog, coordinating delivery across engineering, analysts, and the Sector Lead. Your focus will be on turning Kpler's data foundation into a native automotive intelligence workspace that delivers actionable insights and enables customers to make better decisions.
The product will span key areas including trade flows and lane capacity, schedule reliability, fleet supply and renewal, charter rates and asset values, ports and terminals, fuel and emissions, CII, and bunkering. This is an exciting opportunity to help build a new product vertical within Kpler, shaping both the customer experience and the way our data is transformed into intelligence.

Key Responsibilities
- Own the Automotive Intelligence product roadmap and backlog , translating sector strategy and validated customer needs into well-defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria across the product's seven intelligence modules.

- Prioritise product initiatives by balancing customer value, commercial impact, technical effort, data readiness, and delivery constraints , ensuring the team focuses on the highest-impact opportunities.

- Partner closely with the Sector Lead, Data Engineers, and Automotive Analyst to translate market intelligence, customer discovery, and business requirements into scalable product capabilities.

- Coordinate delivery across engineering and data teams, ensuring the roadmap accounts for technical dependencies across Kpler's AIS, ownership, emissions, and other underlying data sources .

- Define and shape the automotive workspace experience , ensuring it integrates naturally within Kpler's platform, surfaces the most important executive KPIs, and delivers actionable insights rather than simply presenting data.

- Own the product delivery cadence , including sprint planning, backlog refinement, release coordination, and stakeholder communication, ensuring the Q4 2026 launch and subsequent roadmap remain on track.

- Conduct customer discovery and continuously incorporate customer and market feedback into product requirements, prioritisation, and roadmap decisions.

- Define and track product success metrics , measuring adoption, engagement, customer outcomes, and commercial performance against ARR and logo targets.

- Maintain a healthy and predictable backlog, ensuring clear requirements, effective refinement, delivery visibility, and strong collaboration between Product, Engineering, Data, and commercial teams.

- Uphold strong Product and Engineering standards for quality, documentation, and ways of working as the Automotive Intelligence squad scales.
Skills and Experience 
- 3+ years of Product Owner or Product Management experience , ideally delivering B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products within a cross-functional Agile environment.

- Strong track record of translating strategy and customer needs into a prioritised roadmap, well-defined backlog, and clear product requirements , with a focus on delivering against deadlines.

- Experience working with data-heavy products and technical teams , with the ability to understand data sources, pipelines, technical dependencies, and their implications for product development.

- Strong experience in customer discovery , with the ability to translate customer insights and market feedback into actionable product requirements and roadmap decisions.

- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Data, and customer-facing teams .

- Strong understanding of Agile product ownership, including backlog management, user story writing, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, release coordination, and roadmap planning .

- Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to interpret data, define meaningful product metrics, and measure outcomes and product adoption.

- Familiarity with product and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, roadmap management, and product analytics platforms .

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate clearly across different disciplines and levels of seniority.

- A decisive and structured approach to prioritisation, with the confidence to make trade-offs, say no when required, and clearly communicate the rationale behind product decisions.

- An ownership mindset, comfortable operating with ambiguity and working at pace in a new and evolving product area.
Nice to have 
- Experience or knowledge of maritime, shipping, logistics, automotive, commodities, or trade intelligence .

- Familiarity with AIS, vessel tracking, freight/charter markets, emissions, or port and terminal operations .

- Experience launching new products or modules within an existing platform.
We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Marine Insurance
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


As Senior Product Manager, Marine Insurance, you will own the Marine Insurance product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address critical challenges across the marine insurance value chain.
Your initial focus will be on building an exposure screening product for insured fleets, enabling customers to load their insured fleet, attach policy values, and continuously monitor exposure and accumulation against the live global fleet picture.
This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with underwriters, brokers, P&I clubs, claims and exposure-management teams, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure the product solves real customer problems and establishes Kpler as a trusted source of marine insurance intelligence.
The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.



Key Responsibilities 
- Own the Marine Insurance product strategy, vision, and roadmap , defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.

- Lead the development and delivery of the first Marine Insurance product release , focused on exposure screening across the live global fleet and enabling customers to monitor exposure and accumulation continuously.

- Lead market and customer discovery with hull and cargo underwriters, war-risk underwriters, P&I clubs, brokers, claims, and exposure-management teams to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction.

- Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience , ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for insurance professionals.

- Establish the exposure and accumulation methodology underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the methodology is credible, transparent, and trusted by underwriters and brokers.

- Own positioning and competitive strategy , monitoring the marine insurance analytics landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation and value proposition.

- Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption.

- Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the insurance ecosystem that can accelerate adoption or strengthen the underlying data proposition.

- Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing , creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes.

- Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact.
Skills and Experience 
- 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience , ideally within maritime data, shipping intelligence, marine insurance, or a closely related B2B data/SaaS environment.

- Proven track record of owning products end-to-end , from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption.

- Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements , working closely with Product and Engineering teams.

- Strong understanding of the marine insurance data landscape , including exposure, accumulation, sanctions, and war-risk screening, as well as the wider competitive environment.

- Experience operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments , with a pragmatic and iterative approach to building, launching, learning, and improving products.

- Strong commercial and go-to-market experience , including product positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and working closely with Sales and Marketing.

- Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to work effectively with data and engineering teams and understand maritime and trade data concepts such as AIS, ownership, and trade flows .

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, commercial, and senior external audiences.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders across different levels and functions.

- Strong ownership mindset and a bias to action , with the confidence to make decisions, navigate uncertainty, and focus on delivering outcomes rather than perfection.
Nice to have
- Direct experience within marine insurance , particularly hull and machinery, cargo, war risk, or P&I.

- Experience building and launching a new product line rather than managing an established product.

- An established network across underwriters, brokers, and P&I clubs .

- Understanding of the regulatory environment affecting marine insurance, including sanctions regimes and war-risk designations .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.
Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements.
This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence.
The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.



Key Responsibilities 
- Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap , defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.

- Lead the development and delivery of the first Fisheries product release , focused on live fleet monitoring and subsequently catch and yield reporting that procurement and compliance teams can rely on.

- Lead market and customer discovery with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction.

- Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience , ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for customers across the seafood supply chain.

- Establish the vessel identity, dark-behaviour, and catch-estimation methodologies underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the outputs are credible, transparent, and trusted.

- Own positioning and competitive strategy , monitoring the existing commercial and NGO-adjacent landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation.

- Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption.

- Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the seafood supply chain, including data, certification, and distribution partnerships that can strengthen the product and accelerate adoption.

- Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing , creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes.

- Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact.
Skills and Responsibilities 
- 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience , ideally within maritime data, seafood supply chains, or a related B2B data/SaaS environment.

- Proven track record of owning products end-to-end , from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption.

- Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements , working closely with Product and Engineering teams.

- Strong understanding of the fisheries data landscape , including vessel tracking, IUU risk, catch documentation, and supply chain traceability.

- Experience operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments , with a pragmatic and iterative approach to building, launching, learning, and improving products.

- Strong commercial and go-to-market experience , including product positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and working closely with Sales and Marketing.

- Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to work effectively with data and engineering teams and understand maritime and trade data concepts such as AIS, vessel identity, geospatial analysis, ownership, and flows .

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, commercial, regulatory, and NGO audiences .

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior external stakeholders.

- Strong ownership mindset and a bias to action , with the confidence to make decisions, navigate uncertainty, and focus on delivering outcomes rather than perfection.
Nice to have 
- Direct experience within the fisheries or seafood sector , particularly procurement, traceability, or certification.

- Experience building and launching a new product line rather than managing an established product.

- An established network across seafood buyers, certification bodies, regulators, or fisheries NGOs .

- Understanding of relevant fisheries regulations, including IUU regulations, US SIMP, or the EU carding system .
